fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "April 2016, in Spina's own account", "body": "Chance Garton opens with an invocation and hands the floor to RJ Spina, who dates his story to April 23rd, 2016. By his own account, Spina was diagnosed with sepsis, told he had 48 hours to live, encouraged to write a will, and left paralyzed from the chest down by an infection compressing his spine from T5 through T10. He describes waking at 3 a.m. in the ICU after an emergency laminectomy, feeling nothing below his chest, and says the neurosurgeon told him the damage was permanent. Spina also says his earliest childhood memories are of leaving his body."}, {"title": "One hundred days, as he describes them", "body": "Asked what those hundred days were like, Spina describes agony rather than triumph. He says the first thirteen days brought no sensation below the chest, that rehab ran twice a day for ninety minutes at a facility attached to Sharp Memorial Hospital, and that he asked his doctor for very strong painkillers because he could not bear being touched or moved. He recounts telling an insurance wheelchair representative that he would not need the chair, and says hospital staff filmed him because he expected no one to believe him. Garton then picks the word agony apart, tracing it to the Greek agon, meaning contest or struggle."}, {"title": "Limitation programs and the subconscious mind", "body": "Spina's second book, Change Your Mind, published in August 2023, argues that the subconscious mind is responsible for 95 percent of the reality we create and the thinking mind for only 5 percent. Until a buried limitation program is recognized as something other than the self and deleted, he contends, a person can only recycle the same failed relationships, failed businesses and failed attempts. He names the culprit as societal conditioning and brainwashing, and labels the pattern the ego mind identity, or EMI, borrowing the physics term electromagnetic interference. Garton links it to his own biofield tuning sessions, where he traces repeating life patterns back to formative and pre-memory experience."}, {"title": "Evolutionary tension and the frequency model", "body": "Asked why conditioning and dissonance exist at all, Spina answers with what he calls evolutionary tension: without something pushing down on you, he argues, there is no growth, and incarnation into the bottom three frequencies that give us height, width and depth is an accelerant for the evolution of consciousness. He illustrates it with Olympic diving and degree of difficulty, and rejects good and evil as a religious frame in favor of high and low frequency. He also describes a moment lying in bed when, he says, all so-called knowledge and all experience were seen as the same thing and simply fell away."}, {"title": "Permission, attention and the year ahead", "body": "Asked whether someone should quit work they resent in order to focus, Spina says the first move in his framing is to give yourself permission, since a doctor, clergy member, spouse or pharmacist may never hand it over, and to stop spending energy on what he calls energetic placeholders. Garton widens the idea to permission to have fun or to enjoy life. Spina then walks through his 2024 schedule, a three day San Diego event in February, a Kauai retreat, and courses including The Bible Deconstructed. In the outro Garton reflects on his own leap out of a day job and says he needs a bigger dream."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: A new year of InnerVerse kicks off with a paradigm busting pow-wow about the power of our higher mind to transform our material body in astounding ways. In 2016, RJ Spina became permanently paralyzed (according to his surgeons and doctors), waking up in the hospital with no feeling or movement from the chest down. Tune in to find out how RJ intuitively, miraculously, and fully healed from this incurable condition, the eternal metaphysical truths that his experience reveals, how to get into the driver's seat of the miracle machine, and much more.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In the Plus+ Extension, RJ walks us through a demonstration of the Ascend the Frequencies healing technique that he used to reignite dead nerves in his spine. We also discuss mental strategies to invoke ideas and inspiration, Ascended Masters and the Bible Deconstructed, the emanations of the absolute source, and bridging astrotheology with one's personal philosophy.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Channeling Intelligent Energy Through the Crown", "body": "Spina opens the extension by walking Chance through the first of seven steps in his Ascend the Frequencies technique, framing it as a personal version of what Tesla tapped, a free energy that is always present and needs only an open receiver. He has listeners rest two fingers on the top of the head, bring all attention to that point of contact, then gently reach out from inside the skull to meet the fingertips, which he likens to the petals of a flower opening. Chance reports feeling it live on air, describing the sensation as cold heat."}, {"title": "Self-Discipline as the Engine of Self-Healing", "body": "Pressed on why a technique alone is not enough, Spina argues that limitations begin exactly where discipline ends, and that mastery of one's own energy is the only real control a person holds. Chance connects this to Saturn, reframing the planet usually cast as the great limiter and boogeyman of the chart as a teacher of order and consequence. Spina extends the point into what he calls self-mastery, which he places beyond enlightenment because its target lies nowhere outside the self, and insists that what was taken from humanity was the process, never the capacity."}, {"title": "Thinking, Thanking, and the Movement of the Past", "body": "The conversation turns on Spina's claim that thinking is only a movement of the past, a mental flip through a Rolodex of memory that gets thrown out in front of you and stepped into, so that a person who thinks constantly never tastes an unlimited capacity to create. Chance draws the etymological link between think and thank and offers the swap as a practical clearing move for repetitive thought, while carefully distinguishing that mental churn from genuine ideas, which he describes as the spontaneity arriving when someone is fully engaged in what they are doing."}, {"title": "Desire, Intention, and the Order of Creation", "body": "Spina lays out what he presents as the actual sequence by which anything manifests, running desire, intention, thought, emotion, action and behavior, with the earliest terms carrying the highest frequency and every later one costing awareness. He rejects the familiar spiritual formula that desire causes suffering, assigning that role to identification instead and casting desire as the force that sets creation into motion. Chance answers with the Latin root behind the word, reading desire as of the stars and tying it to the same root that gives astrology its sidereal reckoning."}, {"title": "The Virgin Birth, Ascended Masters, and Twelve Gods", "body": "Asked about his Bible Deconstructed course, Spina gives an account of the Immaculate Conception in which Joseph, whom he identifies as the master of alchemy and the same soul as Saint Germain, Plato, Merlin and Moses, opened a portal by placing his hand on Mary's lower belly. Chance answers with the Protogonos of the ancient mystery schools and the roughly six hundred year Neros cycle he says the Vatican brought to an end. Spina closes by describing twelve original gods, the Elohim, each sending pieces of itself out as the masters."}]
